summary: The recorded base reproduced both synchronous preprocessing starvation paths and real ASGI /ping starvation. The exact candidate passed all three unchanged regressions and an independent concurrency/context/exception-recovery stress case. Both original blocking paths are offloaded through a serialized, context-propagating worker.

tests.command: python test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_base_event_loop.py (recorded base with candidate regression only)
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced synchronous OpenAI request conversion blocking the API event loop.

tests.command: python test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_event_loop.py (recorded base with candidate regression only)
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced regular tokenizer fallback blocking the API event loop; serialization/context tests were skipped because the base lacks the executor.

tests.command: python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_liveness.py (recorded base with candidate regression only)
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced /ping starvation through real in-process FastAPI chat and ping routes.
OpenAI conversion no longer starved an independent event-loop coroutine.
Regular tokenizer responsiveness, single-worker serialization, and ContextVar propagation passed.
Real in-process /ping remained schedulable while chat preprocessing was blocked.
Independent 50-request stress verified isolated ContextVars, maximum concurrency one, exception propagation, and executor recovery.

gpu_execution.evidence: The deterministic defect and all reviewed paths execute in CPU request preprocessing before scheduler/GPU work; no GPU claim is made.

native_rebuilt_reason: Candidate changes only Python source, tests, and report artifacts; no native source or extension changed.
remaining_limitations: No model weights, inference output, semantic accuracy, distributed serving, or architecture-specific GPU behavior were tested because they are outside the pre-scheduler CPU responsiveness contract.
The candidate uses an unbounded ThreadPoolExecutor submission queue; overload/backpressure policy was not part of the original issue contract.
git diff --check reports trailing whitespace only in candidate-retained raw pytest log artifacts, not in changed source or tests.
